title: GAFC Safe Storage Challenge
body:
🔒🍗 Yo, GAFC fam! Real talk: Safety ain't just a word, it's a lifestyle. Especially when little ones are around. 🏡

Gloxsie 21 always keeps it tight, but Bobo Licious here sometimes learns the hard way! 😅 So let's level up together. 

Scenario: You're home after a long day. Kids are playing. Your firearm needs to be stored. What's the smart move?

A. Tuck it under the mattress for quick access. Who gonna know? 🤔 (Bobo's 'maybe later' idea!)

B. Unloaded, secured in a lockbox, ammo separate. That's the GAFC standard. ✅ (Gloxsie's wise move!)

As Pastor Jenkins at Church of Legacy often reminds us, 'Our faith in self-reliance means protecting our own, always.' 

Hit the poll below and show us how you stay sharp! 👇 Which choice keeps your legacy safe for generations? #CommunityFirst

#GAFC #GunSafety #SafeStorage #ProtectYourLegacy #YouthSafety #ResponsibleGunOwner #CommunitySafety #BlackOwned
